coverage: HD Re:Chain of Memories reference: both campaigns, card discoveries, 41 world rewards, sleights, six Mini-games, 12 Riku world decks, Moogle packs and Steam goals. Card coverage is partial: World/Gimmick and all Riku Battle Card entries are not yet reconciled. Counts describe this guide, not the native 100% requirement. CP conflicts remain unresolved.
